_meta.title: Push-surface ratchet ceilings (#1273)
_meta.description: Anti-regrowth ratchet on the always-pushed context layer. Each surface has two ceilings (items and bytes); the guard fails red when a surface exceeds either. CONTEXT.md as a whole file is deliberately NOT capped (see context_md_whole_file).
_meta.item_definition: An 'item' is a line whose stripped form is a bullet ('- ', '* ', or '+ ' at any nesting depth) or a numbered list line ('N. ' or 'N) '). Block-level HTML comments (<!-- ... -->) are excluded before counting. Fenced code, YAML frontmatter, and .claude/rules/* files without a paths: key are all COUNTED — they are pushed at session start. This definition is load-bearing and is asserted by a synthetic-fixture test in tests/ci/test_push_surface_guard.py.

margin.statement: Ceilings = per-surface 90-day maximum (git-history max over the last 90 days, computed at fixture-writing time 2026-07-31) + 20% margin, rounded up. context_md_pushed was re-measured 2026-07-31 after the #1271 section-aware push (compressed Invariants + Glossary category index) replaced the 8 KiB byte-slice; its ceiling follows the same 20%-margin policy as the other surfaces — the push is no longer hard-bounded by a cap constant, only by the 9,500-char assembly budget.
margin.uuids: Each surface entry carries the record_decision UUID that set its ceiling (adjacent comment), per the Quota-Probe.ps1 precedent. Bumping a ceiling without a fresh record_decision UUID is a review failure.

provenance.source: Issue #1273 records aggregate 90-day maxima of 129 items / 49,632 bytes across the four source files. Per-surface ceilings here are computed from per-surface git-history maxima: soul_md 38/9512, project_claude_md 65/25283 (pre-#1252 compression), userlevel_claude_md 30/16498, userlevel_doctrine_md 9/6870 (file created 2026-07-30, max == current), context_md_pushed 37 items / 5,143 bytes (re-measured 2026-07-31 after the #1271 section-aware push).

_meta.same_pr_raise: The JSON IS the fixture: the guard reads ceilings only from this file, so raising a ceiling is impossible without editing it in the same PR. Regrowth is therefore a reviewable act.

assembly.note: The pushed CONTEXT.md part is measured by calling the real assembler (_load_project_context — section-aware push of compressed Invariants + Glossary category index), NOT by reimplementing the extraction. A new push surface in the assembly that the fixture does not list fails red (see test_fixture_covers_discovered_surfaces).

context_md_whole_file.note: CONTEXT.md as a whole file has NO ceiling — pull-only Glossary bodies may grow freely (that is the push/pull split). Only the pushed part (surface context_md_pushed: Invariants + Glossary category index) is ratcheted.

soul_md.note: Identity. Loaded via a bare `@SOUL.md` import in .claude-userlevel/CLAUDE.md, not a SessionStart hook step (#1328).

project_claude_md.note: Repo rules. Loaded by the harness into every jarvis session.

userlevel_claude_md.note: User-level CLAUDE.md source (installer source, not the repo-local mirror). Loaded into every session on every device.

userlevel_doctrine_md.note: Shared cross-repo norms, @import-ed from user-level CLAUDE.md.

context_md_pushed.note: The pushed part of CONTEXT.md — compressed ## Invariants + Glossary category index (per-term ### Index and category bodies are pull-only), re-measured 2026-07-31 after #1271 replaced the 8 KiB byte-slice. Ceiling = measured 37 items / 5,143 bytes + 20% margin, rounded up. The whole push must fit the 9,500-char assembly budget on its own (see test_assembly_cap_pinned).
